semiconductor_relevance: Low — The company specializes in HVAC-related air and chemical filters, which are peripheral to semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
summary: Mechmaark Filtech India Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer of industrial air and chemical filters, primarily serving the HVAC industry. Their products are designed to meet international quality standards and are used in air management systems, which can be relevant for maintaining cleanroom environments in semiconductor fabs.

regional_presence.India: Headquartered in New Delhi with a manufacturing facility in Bahadurgarh, Haryana.
